+private theorem flasqueAlpha_isIso {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)

+    (hI : ∀ n : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
+      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (I.K.X n))) (p : ℕ) :
+    IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (cupCechAlpha U I) p) := by
+  let symmetry : TotalComplexShapeSymmetry
+      (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) :=
+    { symm := fun i j ↦ Nat.add_comm j i
+      σ := fun i j ↦ (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (i * j)
+      σ_ε₁ := by
+        rintro i _ rfl j
+        dsimp
+        rw [mul_one, Nat.add_mul, one_mul, pow_add, mul_left_comm,
+          Int.units_mul_self, mul_one]
+      σ_ε₂ := by
+        rintro i j _ rfl
+        dsimp
+        rw [one_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, pow_add] }

+  let A := cupSections I
+  let a : A ⟶ K.flip.X 0 :=
+    { f := fun n ↦ moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n)
+      comm' := fun n m _ ↦ by
+        change moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫
+            ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).map
+              ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
+                (I.K.d n m).val)).f 0 =
+          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).map
+            (I.K.d n m) ≫ moduleCechZero U (I.K.X m)
+        exact moduleCechZero_naturality U (I.K.d n m) }
+  have ha : a ≫ K.flip.d 0 1 = 0 := by
+    apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
+    intro n
+    change moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫
+      ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj
+        (I.K.X n).presheafModuleCat).d 0 1 = 0
+    exact moduleCechZero_d U (I.K.X n)
+  let b := cupCechAlpha U I ≫ (K.totalFlipIso (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).inv
+  have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, b.f n = a.f n ≫
+      K.flip.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 n n (by simp) := by
+    intro n
+    dsimp only [b, HomologicalComplex.comp_f, cupCechAlpha,
+      cupCechAlphaComponent, a]
+    rw [Category.assoc, K.ιTotal_totalFlipIso_f_inv]
+    change (1 : ℤˣ) • moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫

+      ((CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv (K.flip.flip.X n) (A.X n)).symm

+      (K.totalFlipIso (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).inv

+private theorem cupCech_comparison_squares {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
+    {F : X.Modules} (I : CupAcyclicResolution F)
+    (J : InjectiveResolution F) (ψ : I.K ⟶ J.cocomplex)
+    (hψ : I.augmentation.f 0 ≫ ψ.f 0 = J.ι.f 0) :
+    let T := HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
+      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
+        PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op ⋙
+          CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).mapHomologicalComplex
+            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) |>.map ψ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)

+      ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
+        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map ψ ≫ moduleCechAlpha U J ∧
+    cupCechBeta U I ≫ T =
+      moduleCechBeta U J := by
+  dsimp only
+  constructor
+  · apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
+    funext n
+    dsimp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, cupCechAlpha, cupCechAlphaComponent, moduleCechAlpha,
+      moduleCechAlphaComponent]
+    rw [Category.assoc, HomologicalComplex₂.ιTotal_map]
+    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
+    congr 1
+    dsimp [moduleCechZero]
+    apply Pi.hom_ext
+    intro y
+    simp only [CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor,
+      FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor_map_f, Functor.rightOp_obj, homOfLE_leOfHom,
+      Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_map_f, Functor.comp_map, SheafOfModules.forget_map,

+      (I.K.X n).presheafModuleCat.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := ∏ᶜ fun l => U (z l)))).op) ≫
+        Pi.π _ y ≫ _ =

+        (J.cocomplex.X n).presheafModuleCat.map
+          (homOfLE (le_top (a := ∏ᶜ fun l => U (z l)))).op) ≫ Pi.π _ y

+    ext x

+    rw [Category.assoc, HomologicalComplex₂.ιTotal_map]

+        CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U
+    change (C.map (I.augmentation.f 0)).f n ≫ (C.map (ψ.f 0)).f n ≫ _ =
+      (C.map (J.ι.f 0)).f n ≫ _
+    rw [← Category.assoc, ← HomologicalComplex.comp_f, ← C.map_comp, hψ]

+/-- Alpha for a flasque resolution is invertible on homology, and equality of alpha
+and beta classes is exactly the canonical Cech comparison equation.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 01EQ, 0FKV (flasque-resolution diagram).
+(blueprint: lem-sc-cup-cech-flasque-comparison)
+
+Proof: each term of D.K is Cech-acyclic for a covering, and its zeroth Cech
+cohomology is its global sections. The first-quadrant column augmentation
+criterion makes cupCechAlpha a quasi-isomorphism. Apply the Cech functor to
+D.comparison. Restrictions commute with its components, giving the alpha square;
+D.over gives the beta square. On homology the global comparison is invertible
+by D.computes, while the injective alpha is invertible by moduleCechAlpha_isIso.
+The defining equation hc for D.I and these squares imply the stated class
+identity, after cancelling the injective alpha and the resolution identification.
+The argument works in degree zero and for empty schemes: it only cancels these
+isomorphisms and never assumes the represented class is nonzero. -/
+theorem cupCech_flasque_comparison {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
+    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤) {F : X.Modules}
+    (D : CupAcyclicResolution F)
+    (hD : ∀ n : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
+      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (D.K.X n))) :
+    QuasiIso (cupCechAlpha U D) ∧
+    ∀ (n : ℕ)
+      (c : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).homology n ⟶
+        (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace n).obj F),
+      IsModuleCechComparison U F n c →
+      ∀ (a : (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).sc n).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
+        (b : ((cupSections D).sc n).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K),
+        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (cupCechAlpha U D) n (cupCycleClass _ n b) =
+          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (cupCechBeta U D) n (cupCycleClass _ n a) →
+        D.class n b = c (cupCycleClass _ n a)  := by
+  constructor
+  · rw [quasiIso_iff]
+    intro n
+    exact (quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap _ _).2 (flasqueAlpha_isIso U hU D hD n)
+  · intro n c hc a b hab
+    let : EnoughInjectives X.Modules :=
+      (RingedSpace.moduleSheaves_abelian_enoughInjectives X.toRingedSpace).2
+    let := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor_additive X.toRingedSpace
+    let T := HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
+      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
+        PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op ⋙
+          CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).mapHomologicalComplex
+            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) |>.map D.comparison) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+    let g := ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
+      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map D.comparison
+    have hzero : D.augmentation.f 0 ≫ D.comparison.f 0 = D.I.ι.f 0 :=
+      congrArg (fun f ↦ f.f 0) D.over
+    obtain ⟨hα, hβ⟩ := cupCech_comparison_squares U D D.I D.comparison hzero
+    have hα' := congrArg (fun f ↦ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f n) hα
+    have hβ' := congrArg (fun f ↦ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f n) hβ
+    simp only [HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp] at hα' hβ'
+    have heq : HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechAlpha U D.I) n
+        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap g n (cupCycleClass _ n b)) =
+        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechBeta U D.I) n
+          (cupCycleClass _ n a) := by
+      calc
+        _ = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap T n
+            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (cupCechAlpha U D) n
+              (cupCycleClass _ n b)) := (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hα' _).symm
+        _ = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap T n
+            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (cupCechBeta U D) n
+              (cupCycleClass _ n a)) := by rw [hab]
+        _ = _ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hβ' _
+    have hcan := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hc D.I) (cupCycleClass _ n a)
+    have := moduleCechAlpha_isIso U hU D.I n
+    have hinj := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective
+      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechAlpha U D.I) n)).mp inferInstance
+    have hclass := hinj (heq.trans hcan.symm)
+    change (D.I.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) n).inv
+      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap g n (cupCycleClass _ n b)) = _
+    rw [hclass]
+    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+      (D.I.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) n).hom_inv_id
+      (c (cupCycleClass _ n a))
+
+end

+Source: Stacks Project, Section 20.31 (0FKU), naive cup product and the

+quasi-isomorphic augmentations and tensor cochain map supplied by
+moduleCup_godement_pairing. Restrict to natural degrees. On each tensor summand,
+tensor sections and apply the supplied chain map; its cochain identity gives
+signed Leibniz, and its degree-zero formula gives augmentation_pair. Restrictions
+commute because its components are sheaf morphisms. Choose injective resolutions
+and extend each augmentation to a comparison degree by degree by injectivity.

+cited Leray acyclic-resolution comparison criterion makes every global comparison

+assumed, and no coefficient flatness is required. -/
+theorem exists_cupCechFlasquePairing {X : Scheme.{uM}} (F G : X.Modules) :

+        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (D.right.K.X n))) ∧
+      (∀ n : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
+        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (D.target.K.X n))) := by

+  have := hb
+  have := hc
+  have := hK
+  have := hL
+  have := hM

+  have := natAugmentation_quasiIso b
+  have := natAugmentation_quasiIso c

+          ((L.X (s : ℤ)).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op y)
+    have hres := tensorSection_restriction

+/-! # The signed Cech total cochain morphism
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 01EQ and 0FKV.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-cup-cech-total-cochain-pairing)
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+universe u
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false

+/-- The signed Alexander-Whitney morphism of the total Cech complexes of a resolution
+pairing preserves restrictions of global sections and coefficient augmentations.
+Source: Stacks Project, equation 07MB, and the flasque diagram in Lemma 0FKV.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-cup-cech-total-cochain-pairing)
+
+Proof: on a tensor of summands with bidegrees (r,i) and (s,j), restrict the
+front i-face and back j-face to their common intersection, apply D.pair r s,
+multiply by (-1)^(i*s), and include in the target summand (r+s,i+j).
+These bilinear formulas extend across the tensor product and finite coproducts
+in every total degree. For the resolution differential, D.leibniz and the
+Koszul factor (-1)^(i*s) give the tensor cochain identity. For the Cech
+differential, expand the alternating omitted-vertex sums: the front and back
+terms agree with the respective input differentials, and the two middle
+terms cancel. Restriction compatibility of D.pair permits each composition of
+restrictions to be replaced by its composite. These calculations prove the
+cochain identity on pure tensors in each summand, hence on the whole total
+term. On alpha summands i=j=0 all signs are one and restriction compatibility
+gives the first equation. On beta summands r=s=0 the signs are again one;
+D.augmentation_pair gives the second equation tuple by tuple. The same
+finite-diagonal formulas cover degree zero, empty covers and zero sheaves. -/
+theorem exists_cupCech_total_cochain_pairing {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
+    (U : ι → X.Opens) {F G : X.Modules} (D : CupResolutionPairing F G) :
+    let A := (cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+    let B := (cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+    let C := (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+    ∃ h : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)))
+        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶ C,
+      (∀ (p q : ℕ) (a : (cupSections D.left).X p) (b : (cupSections D.right).X q),
+        h.f (p + q)
+          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)))
+            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q (p + q) rfl
+            (((cupCechAlpha U D.left).f p a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
+              ((cupCechAlpha U D.right).f q b))) =
+        (cupCechAlpha U D.target).f (p + q) (D.pair p q ⊤ a b)) ∧
+      (∀ (p q : ℕ)
+        (a : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).X p)
+        (b : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj G.presheafModuleCat).X q),
+        h.f (p + q)
+          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)))
+            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q (p + q) rfl
+            (((cupCechBeta U D.left).f p a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
+              ((cupCechBeta U D.right).f q b))) =
+        (cupCechBeta U D.target).f (p + q) (cechCupCochain U F G p q a b)) := by sorry
+
+end
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

+/-! # Cech total complexes of computing resolutions
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 01EQ and 0FKV.
+(blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total)
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+universe u
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
+open CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- Global sections of a computing resolution.
+Source: Stacks 0FKV (blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total). -/
+abbrev cupSections {X : Scheme.{u}} {F : X.Modules} (D : CupAcyclicResolution F) :=
+  ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
+    (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.K
+
+/-- Components of the map from global sections of the resolution to its Čech total complex.
+Source: Stacks 01EQ (blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total). -/
+noncomputable def cupCechAlphaComponent {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
+    (U : ι → X.Opens) {F : X.Modules} (I : CupAcyclicResolution F) (n : ℕ) :
+    (cupSections I).X n ⟶
+      ((cupCechDouble U I.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).X n :=
+  moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫
+    (cupCechDouble U I.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n 0 n (by simp)
+
+/-- The alpha components commute with the differential. Source: Stacks 01EQ
+(blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total).
+Proof: restrictions commute with the resolution differential. The Čech differential
+of the restrictions of a global section is zero. The total differential on the (n,0)
+summand is the resolution differential plus (-1)^n times that zero differential. -/
+theorem cupCechAlpha_comm {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
+    {F : X.Modules} (I : CupAcyclicResolution F) (n m : ℕ) :
+    cupCechAlphaComponent U I n ≫
+        ((cupCechDouble U I.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).d n m =
+      (cupSections I).d n m ≫ cupCechAlphaComponent U I m := by
+  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
+  · dsimp only [cupCechAlphaComponent]
+    rw [HomologicalComplex₂.total_d, Preadditive.comp_add,
+      Category.assoc, Category.assoc, HomologicalComplex₂.ι_D₁,
+      HomologicalComplex₂.ι_D₂,
+      HomologicalComplex₂.d₁_eq _ _ hnm 0 m (by simp [← hnm]),
+      HomologicalComplex₂.d₂_eq' _ _ n (show (0 : ℕ) + 1 = 1 from rfl)]
+    dsimp
+    simp only [one_smul, Linear.comp_units_smul]
+    have hv : moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫
+        ((cupCechDouble U I.K).X n).d 0 1 = 0 := by
+      change moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫
+        ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj
+          (I.K.X n).presheafModuleCat).d 0 1 = 0
+      exact moduleCechZero_d U (I.K.X n)
+    simp only [← Category.assoc, hv,
+      zero_comp, smul_zero, add_zero]
+    have hh : moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫
+        ((cupCechDouble U I.K).d n m).f 0 =
+      (cupSections I).d n m ≫
+        moduleCechZero U (I.K.X m) := by
+      change moduleCechZero U (I.K.X n) ≫
+        ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).map
+          ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
+            (I.K.d n m).val)).f 0 =
+        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).map (I.K.d n m) ≫
+          moduleCechZero U (I.K.X m)
+      exact moduleCechZero_naturality U (I.K.d n m)
+    rw [hh]
+  · rw [HomologicalComplex.shape _ _ _ hnm, HomologicalComplex.shape _ _ _ hnm]
+    simp
+
+/-- The map alpha of Stacks 01EQ (blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total). -/
+noncomputable def cupCechAlpha {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
+    {F : X.Modules} (I : CupAcyclicResolution F) :
+    cupSections I ⟶
+      (cupCechDouble U I.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ) where
+  f := cupCechAlphaComponent U I
+  comm' := fun n m _ => cupCechAlpha_comm U I n m
+
+/-- Components of the augmentation beta into the Čech total complex.
+Source: Stacks 01EQ (blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total). -/
+noncomputable def cupCechBetaComponent {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
+    (U : ι → X.Opens) {F : X.Modules} (I : CupAcyclicResolution F) (n : ℕ) :
+    ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).X n ⟶
+      ((cupCechDouble U I.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).X n :=
+  ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).map
+      ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
+        (I.augmentation.f 0).val)).f n ≫
+    (cupCechDouble U I.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 n n (by simp)
+
+/-- The beta components commute with the differential. Source: Stacks 01EQ
+(blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total).
+Proof: Čech differentials commute with the augmentation. The augmentation followed by
+the resolution differential is zero. On the (0,n) summand the Čech differential has sign +1. -/
+theorem cupCechBeta_comm {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
+    {F : X.Modules} (I : CupAcyclicResolution F) (n m : ℕ) :
+    cupCechBetaComponent U I n ≫
+        ((cupCechDouble U I.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).d n m =
+      ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).d n m ≫
+        cupCechBetaComponent U I m := by
+  by_cases h : n + 1 = m
+  · subst m
+    dsimp [cupCechBetaComponent]
+    rw [HomologicalComplex₂.total_d, Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_add,
+      HomologicalComplex₂.ι_D₁, HomologicalComplex₂.ι_D₂]
+    rw [HomologicalComplex₂.d₁_eq' _ _ (by simp : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel 0 1),
+      HomologicalComplex₂.d₂_eq _ _ 0 (by simp : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel n (n + 1))
+        (n + 1) (by simp)]
+    simp only [PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat_map, ComplexShape.ε₁_def,
+      one_smul, ComplexShape.ε₂_def, ComplexShape.ε_zero, Preadditive.comp_add]
+    let T := SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
+      PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op ⋙
+        CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U
+    have hz : I.augmentation.f 0 ≫ I.K.d 0 1 = 0 := by
+      rw [I.augmentation.comm 0 1]
+      simp
+    have hz' : (T.map (I.augmentation.f 0)).f n ≫ (T.map (I.K.d 0 1)).f n = 0 := by
+      rw [← HomologicalComplex.comp_f, ← T.map_comp, hz, T.map_zero]
+      rfl
+    have hc := (T.map (I.augmentation.f 0)).comm n (n + 1)
+    change (T.map (I.augmentation.f 0)).f n ≫ (T.map (I.K.d 0 1)).f n ≫ _ +
+      (T.map (I.augmentation.f 0)).f n ≫ (T.obj (I.K.X 0)).d n (n + 1) ≫ _ = _
+    rw [← Category.assoc, hz', zero_comp, zero_add, ← Category.assoc, hc,
+      Category.assoc]
+    rfl
+  · rw [HomologicalComplex.shape _ _ _ h, HomologicalComplex.shape _ _ _ h]
+    simp
+
+/-- The map beta of Stacks 01EQ (blueprint: def-sc-cup-cech-total). -/
+noncomputable def cupCechBeta {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
+    {F : X.Modules} (I : CupAcyclicResolution F) :
+    (CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat ⟶
+      (cupCechDouble U I.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ) where
+  f := cupCechBetaComponent U I
+  comm' := fun n m _ => cupCechBeta_comm U I n m
+
+end
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

+
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 01EQ and 0FKV.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-cup-cech-total-pairing)

+
+@[expose] public section

+universe u

+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false

+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
+open scoped TensorProduct
+open HomologicalComplex
+noncomputable section
+
+private theorem tensor_cycles_nat {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
+    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) ℕ) (n : ℕ)
+    (s : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
+    (a : A.cycles s.1.1) (b : B.cycles s.1.2) :
+    ∃ z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).cycles n,
+      (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).iCycles n z =
+      ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+        s.1.1 s.1.2 n s.2 ((A.iCycles s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles s.1.2 b)) := by
+  let T := mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+  let x := ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+    s.1.1 s.1.2 n s.2 ((A.iCycles s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles s.1.2 b))
+  have ha : A.d s.1.1 (s.1.1 + 1) (A.iCycles s.1.1 a) = 0 :=
+    congrArg (fun f ↦ f a) (A.iCycles_d s.1.1 (s.1.1 + 1))
+  have hb : B.d s.1.2 (s.1.2 + 1) (B.iCycles s.1.2 b) = 0 :=
+    congrArg (fun f ↦ f b) (B.iCycles_d s.1.2 (s.1.2 + 1))
+  have hx : T.d n (n + 1) x = 0 := by
+    dsimp only [T, x]
+    rw [mapBifunctor.d_eq]
+    change ((ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+      (ComplexShape.up ℕ) s.1.1 s.1.2 n s.2 ≫
+      (mapBifunctor.D₁ A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n (n + 1) +
+       mapBifunctor.D₂ A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n (n + 1)))
+      ((A.iCycles s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles s.1.2 b))) = 0
+    rw [Preadditive.comp_add, mapBifunctor.ι_D₁, mapBifunctor.ι_D₂]
+    rw [mapBifunctor.d₁_eq' A B _ _ (show (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel s.1.1 (s.1.1 + 1) from rfl),
+      mapBifunctor.d₂_eq' A B _ _ s.1.1
+        (show (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel s.1.2 (s.1.2 + 1) from rfl)]
+    simp [curriedTensor, ha, hb]
+  have hx' : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat k) Ab).map (T.sc n).g) x = 0 := by
+    change T.d n ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next n) x = 0
+    rwa [(ComplexShape.up ℕ).next_eq' (show (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel n (n + 1) from rfl)]
+  refine ⟨(T.sc n).cyclesMk x hx', ?_⟩
+  exact (T.sc n).i_cyclesMk x hx'
+
+private theorem tensor_homology_nat {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
+    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) ℕ) (p q n : ℕ) (hpq : p + q = n) :
+    ∃ c : A.homology p →ₗ[k] B.homology q →ₗ[k]
+        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n,
+      ∀ (a : A.cycles p) (b : B.cycles q),
+        ∃ z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).cycles n,
+        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).iCycles n z =
+          ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+            p q n hpq ((A.iCycles p a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles q b)) ∧
+        c (A.homologyπ p a) (B.homologyπ q b) =
+          (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homologyπ n z := by
+  classical
+  let T := mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+  let I : A.cycles p ⊗ B.cycles q ⟶ T.X n :=
+    (A.iCycles p ⊗ₘ B.iCycles q) ≫
+      ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q n hpq
+  have hI : I ≫ T.d n (n + 1) = 0 := by
+    apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
+    intro a b
+    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := tensor_cycles_nat A B n ⟨(p, q), hpq⟩ a b
+    change T.d n (n + 1)
+      (ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+        p q n hpq ((A.iCycles p a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles q b))) = 0
+    rw [← hz]
+    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f z) (T.iCycles_d n (n + 1))
+  let t : A.cycles p ⊗ B.cycles q ⟶ T.cycles n :=
+    T.liftCycles I (n + 1) ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next_eq' rfl) hI
+  have ht : t ≫ T.iCycles n = I := T.liftCycles_i _ _ _ _
+  let c₀ : A.cycles p →ₗ[k] B.cycles q →ₗ[k] T.homology n :=
+    TensorProduct.curry (t ≫ T.homologyπ n).hom
+  have h₁ : ∀ x b, c₀ ((A.sc p).toCycles x) b = 0 := by
+    intro x b
+    by_cases hp : p = 0
+    · subst p
+      have hz : (A.sc 0).toCycles = 0 := by
+        apply (cancel_mono (A.sc 0).iCycles).1
+        rw [(A.sc 0).toCycles_i, zero_comp]
+        exact A.shape _ _ (by simp)
+      simp [hz, c₀]
+    let r := (ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev p
+    have hr : r + 1 = p := by
+      dsimp only [r]
+      rw [(ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev_eq' (show
+        (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel (p - 1) p by change p - 1 + 1 = p; omega)]
+      omega
+    let w := ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
+      r q (n - 1) (by change r + q = n - 1; omega)
+      (x ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles q b))
+    have hw : T.d (n - 1) n w = I (((A.sc p).toCycles x) ⊗ₜ[k] b) := by
+      have hb : B.d q (q + 1) (B.iCycles q b) = 0 :=
+        congrArg (fun f ↦ f b) (B.iCycles_d q (q + 1))
+      dsimp only [w, T]
+      rw [mapBifunctor.d_eq]
+      change ((ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
+        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) r q (n - 1) _ ≫
+        (mapBifunctor.D₁ A B _ _ (n - 1) n +
+         mapBifunctor.D₂ A B _ _ (n - 1) n)) (x ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles q b))) = _
+      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, mapBifunctor.ι_D₁, mapBifunctor.ι_D₂,
+        mapBifunctor.d₁_eq A B _ _ (show (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel r p from hr) q n hpq,
+        mapBifunctor.d₂_eq' A B _ _ r
